Realistic Kreuzberg Asian-fusion venue, sensible Berlin prices, 3 guests matches note, Thursday evening (no weekend/holiday interaction, 21:42 before the 23:00 late-night cutoff). Fully reimbursable: 137.00. Works as a 'valid' case with near-threshold distractors (alcohol at 65% of allowance, tip well under cap); no truffle items.
